title: Wizard on Floating Cliff
description: A bearded wizard in a red robe and pointed hat sits on a wooden platform attached to a massive floating rock formation. He plays a flute while surrounded by lush vines, skulls, a leather satchel, and headphones, overlooking a vast mountainous valley at twilight with other floating islands, a gnarled tree, and a starry sky featuring a comet.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy scene of a bearded wizard wearing a red robe, pointed red hat, and headphones around his neck. He sits on a wooden platform built onto a massive floating rocky cliff covered in moss and vines, playing a wooden flute. Nearby is a gnarled ancient tree with skulls and small creatures. The background shows multiple other floating islands with pine trees, a vast winding river valley below, mountains in the distance, and a starry night sky with constellations and a bright red comet streaking across.
